reading: The sketch lays out a hero landing page: a big nowrap heading, a small nav line, and a grid of colored tiles (some plain gradients, some with stat/quote text) plus two tilted circular badges straddling tile boundaries. Typed notes give exact colors, sizes, copy and positions for every piece, overriding the crossed-out look of two tiles (they are plain color/gradient fills, not images).
